title: The Greeks Want to See Jesus
description:
During the festival some Greeks who had come to worship ask Philip to see Jesus.  
Philip goes to Andrew, and together they bring the message to Jesus.  
Jesus answers: "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified. Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just one seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit." He says that whoever serves him must follow him. Jesus feels his soul troubled, but prays: "Father, glorify your name!" A voice from heaven answers that he has glorified it and will glorify it again.

versions.title: The Greeks Want to See Jesus
versions.description: During the Passover festival, some Greeks who had come to worship asked Philip to let them see Jesus. Philip and Andrew brought the message to him. Jesus answered: "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified. Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just one seed; but if it dies, it bears much fruit." He felt troubled in his soul, yet he prayed: "Father, glorify your name!" A voice from heaven answered that the name had been glorified and would be glorified again.
